description: This file defines the TermShapes class which extends ShapeTableProvider to customize shape rendering for taxonomy terms in OrchardCore CMS. It includes shape discovery, processing, and display logic for terms and term items, with methods for handling content item hierarchies and naming conventions.

classes.name: TermShapes
classes.description: Provides shape templates and processing logic for taxonomy terms and term items in OrchardCore.

methods.name: DiscoverAsync
methods.description: Discovers and registers shape display logic for TermPart, Term, TermItem, and TermContentItem.

methods.name: FindTerm
methods.description: Recursively searches for a term with a specific ContentItemId within a JSON array of terms.

methods.name: FormatName
methods.description: Converts a hyphenated or spaced string into PascalCase format.
